name: release-matrix
description: Separate Release plus the mod matrix over MIDI CC, in one build; the envelope curve draws Decay and Release as separate segments.

drop_hooks.was: bl curve_time: back to stock bl 0x0804ED7C, so the curve's slot 2 is always Decay

edits.was: movw r0,#0x605 (envelope popup: slot 4, the filter envelope amount the OLED never reads, becomes Release)
uxth r1,r1 -> ldr r6,[sp,#8] (curve renderer: r6 = the pushed 4th byte, Release)
uxth r1,r1 -> lsrs r6,r6,#2 (r6 = release width, was the decay width)
